name: SYLCXX Electric Letter Opener
caption:

The envelope slides in and comes out open in about three seconds, one handed, with the blade fully enclosed. It runs on four AA batteries, so there is no cord on the desk.

Rated about 4.5 stars from almost a thousand ratings.
